f.title: Communicate other unanticipated problems to TMDA within 14 calendar days
f.statement: Other situations should be communicated to TMDA within 14 calendar days, namely those that: (a) might materially influence the benefit-risk assessment of the investigational product or would be sufficient to consider changes in product administration or the overall conduct of the clinical investigation; (b) marked haematological and other laboratory abnormalities (other than those meeting the definition of serious) and events that led to an intervention (withdrawal of treatment, dose reduction, significant additional concomitant therapy) other than those reported as SAEs; (c) situations identified by medical and scientific judgement, e.g. a clinically important increase in the rate of an expected serious ADR, a significant hazard to the patient population such as lack of efficacy in a life-threatening disease, or a major safety finding from a newly completed animal study. The regulatory clock starts when the sponsor receives a safety or problem report.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Tanzania (medicinal products, medical devices, herbal medicines, biologicals, BA/BE studies)

f.title: Include investigator and sponsor causality opinions in the report
f.statement: The investigator's opinion on causality and the sponsor's opinion on causality shall be included in the report.
f.applicability: Clinical trials in Tanzania (medicinal products, medical devices, herbal medicines, biologicals, BA/BE studies)

rows.quote: Investigator's opinion on causality and sponsor's opinion on causality shall also be included.
rows.review_note: Review: checked against source, no change. Double-check: quote, level and actor confirmed.
